data.notes: December 2026 in Aspen is anchored by Belly Up’s holiday electronic/indie run, Snow Lodge’s NYE house booking, Wintersköl programming, and select JAS/industry events.

events.title: LCD Soundsystem - New Year's Eve 2026
events.summary: LCD Soundsystem headlines Belly Up Aspen’s New Year’s Eve 2026 show on December 31, with doors at 9:30 pm and showtime at 10:30 pm. This is the key date in the venue’s multi-night holiday run.

events.title: Cloonee
events.summary: House DJ and Hellbent Records founder Cloonee headlines Belly Up Aspen on December 26, 2026. Doors are listed for 8:30 pm with a 9:30 pm show.

events.title: SOFI TUKKER
events.summary: GRAMMY-nominated electronic duo SOFI TUKKER plays Belly Up Aspen on December 29, 2026, one of the venue’s peak holiday-week bookings. Doors are listed for 8:30 pm with a 9:30 pm show.

events.title: ANOTR NYE 2026
events.venueName: The St. Regis Aspen Grand Astor Ballroom
events.summary: The Snow Lodge hosts Dutch house duo ANOTR for its annual New Year’s Eve event at The St. Regis Aspen ballroom. The Tixr event lists a special DJ set, premium open bar from 9:00 pm to midnight, and an event end time of 2:00 am.

events.title: Opiuo
events.summary: Opiuo brings a bass-heavy electronic set to Belly Up Aspen during Wintersköl weekend, with Dreamers Delight listed as support. The show is confirmed for December 12 at 9:30 pm.

events.title: SOFI TUKKER
events.summary: Two intimate late-December Belly Up dates from dance-pop/electronic duo SOFI TUKKER, whose sound leans global, Brazilian-influenced and club-ready.

events.title: nimino
events.summary: UK electronic artist nimino headlines Belly Up Aspen on December 10, 2026. Doors are listed for 8:00 pm with a 9:00 pm show.

events.title: Celebrating Prince Featuring Former Members of New Power Generation
events.summary: Jazz Aspen Snowmass presents a Prince celebration featuring former members of The New Power Generation at the Paul JAS Center. The December 28 performance is listed for 8:00–10:00 pm.

events.title: Two Feet
events.summary: Two Feet plays Belly Up Aspen on December 5, with Golbus listed as support on the ticket link. The show is confirmed for 9:00 pm after 8:00 pm doors.

events.title: Wintersköl 2026
events.summary: Aspen’s annual Wintersköl winter celebration runs December 10–13, 2026 with live music in Wagner Park, a beer festival, bonfire, torchlight parade, fireworks, and Snowmass/Aspen events.

events.title: Aspen Live
events.summary: Aspen Live returns December 3–5, 2026 for its 30th year as an invitation-style music and live-entertainment industry conference at The Limelight Hotel.
